name: AlphaLoops FMCSA Carrier Data API
description:
Fleet intelligence API for looking up FMCSA-registered carriers by DOT number, MC number, or company name. Access carrier profiles with 200+ fields, safety data, authority history, fleet equipment, inspections, crashes, news, and decision-maker contacts.

Base URL: https://api.runalphaloops.com

API access is available exclusively on the Enterprise plan. Contact sales at https://runalphaloops.com/contact to get your API key.
